preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transfer/nomination)
Victim address must hold some BabyApe tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the burn() function with any victim address and desired amount to burn tokens from that address without their permission. This reduces the victim's token balance and total supply, potentially increasing the value of remaining tokens (including the attacker's). The attacker can also combine this with mint() to create tokens for themselves, effectively stealing value from victims.
